messages.content:
You edit flowcharts. Return ONLY a JSON object in this compact format:
{"nodes":[["exact stage label","type",column,row]],"edges":[["exact source label","exact target label","branch label"]]}
Types: start, end, process, decision. Column: 0,1,2; row: 0..7.
Include exactly one start and one end. Use each explicit stage name in the request.
Each stage label must be unique and each edge endpoint must be a stage label. Use an empty string for
ordinary edge labels, and Yes/No on decision branches. Preserve loops and direction.
Place nodes on different grid cells. Prefer downward flow and short edges.
Do not add explanations, markdown, or numeric scores.
Example only (use the actual requested stages instead):
Request: Start -> Check form -> Valid?; Yes -> Accept; No -> Reject; both -> Finish.
Output: {"nodes":[["Start","start",1,0],["Check form","process",1,1],["Valid?","decision",1,2],["Accept","process",0,3],["Reject","process",2,3],["Finish","end",1,4]],"edges":[["Start","Check form",""],["Check form","Valid?",""],["Valid?","Accept","Yes"],["Valid?","Reject","No"],["Accept","Finish",""],["Reject","Finish",""]]}
Every edge has exactly 3 entries. Ordinary edge labels are empty strings.
Never add a self-loop at the end. Include ALL nodes AND edges.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Delivery planning begins", then "Read destination", then the decision "Destination local?". Its Yes branch goes to "Assign bicycle courier"; its No branch goes to "Assign van courier". Both alternative stages lead directly to "Send route details", which leads to "Delivery planning complete".

Current flowchart:
{"nodes": [["Delivery planning begins", "start", 1.0, 0.0], ["Read destination", "process", 1.0, 1.0], ["Destination local?", "decision", 1.0, 2.0], ["Assign bicycle courier", "process", 0.0, 3.0], ["Assign van courier", "process", 2.0, 3.0], ["Send route details", "process", 1.0, 4.0], ["Delivery planning complete", "end", 1.0, 5.0]], "edges": [["Delivery planning begins", "Read destination", ""], ["Read destination", "Destination local?", ""], ["Destination local?", "Assign bicycle courier", "Yes"], ["Destination local?", "Assign van courier", "No"], ["Assign bicycle courier", "Send route details", ""], ["Assign van courier", "Send route details", ""], ["Send route details", "Delivery planning complete", ""]]}

Programmatic feedback:
[{"code": "edge_label_overlap", "severity": "warning", "affected_ids": ["e3", "Destination local?"], "message": "Label of edge e3 overlaps node Destination local? description."}]

Visual feedback:
 Delivery planning begins with Read destination which is then connected with Desioution which is then connected with Assign bicycle courier. If Assign bicycle courier is No then Send route detailed and if Assign van courier is No then Assign van courier. Also, Send route detailed is connected with Delivery planning complete which if Delivery planning complete is Delivery planning complete then Assign bicycle courier and if Delivery planning complete is Delivery planning complete then Send route detailed. Also, Send route detailed is connected with Delivery planning complete which if Delivery planning complete is Delivery planning complete then Assign bicycle courier and if Delivery planning complete is Delivery planning complete then Assign van courier.

Correct this chart using the feedback. Preserve correct stages and connections.
